## Problem

What user or maintainer problem does this change address?

## Change

What behavior changed, and why was this approach chosen?

## Verification

List the commands, tests, or evidence used to verify the change.

## Boundaries

- [ ] Agent workflow references contain no maintainer-only implementation detail.
- [ ] Public state or command changes include compatible migration or rejection behavior.
- [ ] Project Map remains a read-only projection.
- [ ] Generated Project Map assets match their source.
- [ ] `make test` and `make validate` pass.
